name: gpu-errand
description: Let your coding agent run jobs on a Google Colab GPU with a hard compute-unit cap, checked results and a receipt for every run. Includes recipes for game music (ACE-Step), sound effects (Stable Audio Open) and headless Godot captures.

interface.shortDescription: Run a job on a Colab GPU with a spending cap.
interface.longDescription: Send a job to a Google Colab GPU from your agent: a repository command, a headless Godot capture, or a music or sound-effects model. It stops at your compute-unit cap and brings results back with checksums and a receipt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use gpu-errand to plan a Colab GPU job and show me the plan and its unit cap before anything runs.
